definition: II. סוּף proper name, of a location (si vera lectio) named in defining location of Deuteronomic law-giving Deut 1:1 ( מול סוּף , where מוֺל by dissimil. for מוּל ); but read perhaps מִיַּם סוּף ( ᵐ5 πλησίον ρῆς ἐρυθρᾶς , ᵐ5 L + θαλάσσης , ᵑ9 contra mare rubrum ), see I. סוּף .

II. סוּף proper name, of a location (si vera lectio) named in defining location of Deuteronomic law-giving Deut 1:1 (מול סוּף, where מוֺל by dissimil. for מוּל); but read perhaps מִיַּם סוּף (ᵐ5 πλησίον ρῆς ἐρυθρᾶς, ᵐ5L + θαλάσσης, ᵑ9 contra mare rubrum), see I. סוּף.
